def has_door_key(env): return env.carrying is not None and env.carrying.type == "key"

def door_open(env): return any(cell is not None and cell.type == "door" and cell.is_open for x in range(env.width) for y in range(env.height) for cell in [env.grid.get(x, y)])

Both propositions are declared as condition (persistent) kind, and both functions read only the current state through the documented API (`env.carrying`, `env.grid.get`, `env.width`, `env.height`) without comparing against the previous valuation, which is correct for persistent semantics. No imports, no actions, no mutation of the environment or episode memory; syntactically valid Python.
